steps.title: Implement basic table rendering
steps.instruction: Inside the DataTable component, implement the table HTML structure with <thead> and <tbody> elements. In the <thead>, map through the columns prop to create <th> elements with each column's header text. In the <tbody>, map through the data prop to create table rows (<tr>), and within each row, map through columns again to create <td> cells displaying the corresponding data value for each column.
steps.hint: Use v-for directives to loop through columns and data. For the table body, you'll need nested loops: one for rows (data items) and another for cells (columns). Access the data value using the column's field property.
